Read saved published Outlook forecast tables

Source: R/outlook-saved.R
read_boj_outlook.Rd

The default reads structured local data, without HTTP, PDF reads or an extractor, including on first use. Use read_boj_outlook_raw() for general archive discovery and source parsing; no dated release admission list exists. refresh reloads the saved dataset, and never runs the updater.

Usage

read_boj_outlook(
  release = "latest",
  comparison = "current",
  cache_dir = boj_cache_dir(),
  refresh = FALSE,
  offline = FALSE,
  max_age = 24 * 60 * 60,
  timeout = 30,
  retries = 3L,
  wait = 1,
  max_bytes = 16 * 1024^2,
  max_releases = 200L,
  max_pdf_pages = 20L,
  max_text_bytes = 1024^2,
  expected_sha256 = NULL,
  pdftotext = getOption("readboj.pdftotext", unname(Sys.which("pdftotext"))),
  deadline = NULL,
  source = "saved",
  data_dir = boj_outlook_data_dir(),
  measure = NULL,
  statistic = NULL,
  range_scope = NULL
)

Arguments

release

One edition month (YYYY-MM), "latest", or "all".

comparison

"current" (default), "prior", or "all".

cache_dir

Directory used for content-addressed response snapshots. The default is tools::R_user_dir("readboj", "cache"); it is created when needed. Use a package-managed temporary directory in tests.

refresh

Logical scalar. If TRUE, ignore an otherwise usable request snapshot and retrieve the catalogue again.

offline

Logical scalar. If TRUE, make no network request and use a valid cached snapshot only; an absent or stale snapshot raises an readboj_offline_error.

max_age

Non-negative cache age in seconds, or Inf for no age limit. The default is 24 hours.

timeout

Non-negative per-request timeout in seconds. The default is 30 seconds.

retries

Non-negative integer number of retries for transient transport responses or errors. The default is 3L.

wait

Non-negative seconds between requests and retries. The default is one second; waiting is skipped for cached responses and offline reads.

max_bytes

Positive maximum response size in bytes. The default is 8 * 1024^2 (8 MiB), and protects the HTML snapshot before parsing.

max_releases

Maximum archive editions (1 through 1,000); excess fails instead of silently truncating discovery.

max_pdf_pages

Maximum leading pages extracted (1 through 100).

max_text_bytes

Maximum accepted layout text bytes. Coordinate XML is separately bounded to eight times this size. Checked after the bounded subprocess finishes; this is not a streaming disk quota.

expected_sha256

Optional complete SHA-256 pin of the numeric source asset (HTML or PDF). For image-only HTML this is the linked full-text PDF. A single pin is invalid with release = "all"; pin individual editions.

pdftotext

Optional provisioned Poppler executable. HTML tables need no extractor. PDF extraction raises readboj_dependency_error if unavailable; nothing is installed. Consults option readboj.pdftotext, then Sys.which.

deadline

Optional single absolute POSIXct/POSIXlt time shared by the request, retries, and waits. When omitted, a bounded deadline is derived from timeout and retries.

source

"saved" (default) or explicit raw source parsing.

data_dir

Directory shared with update_boj_outlook().

measure, statistic, range_scope

Optional vectors of exact semantic IDs. Unknown IDs raise a parameter error. NULL selects all IDs.

Value

A long data frame preserving all published scalars, explicit NA cells, fiscal and source identities, with edition and saved-snapshot provenance.

Examples

history <- read_boj_outlook("all", comparison = "all",
                            data_dir = tempfile("outlook-data-"))
#> Error: No valid saved Outlook dataset is available.
head(history[c("release", "fiscal_year", "measure", "statistic", "value")])
#> Error in history[c("release", "fiscal_year", "measure", "statistic", "value")]: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
